About.title: About
About.headline: A small programme, done properly
About.lede: Rathmore is a family breeding programme in County Meath. We plan one or two Golden Retriever litters a year from fully health-tested parents, raise every puppy in the kitchen, and stay in touch with our families for the life of the dog.
About.story1: The dogs live with us, not in a barn out the back. Puppies are born in the kitchen, handled from day one, and spend their first eight weeks around the sounds of a working farmhouse — the kettle, the radio, children, other dogs, the odd tractor in the yard.
About.story2: We are not in a hurry. A planned litter waits until the dam is ready and the clearances are current. If a year has no litter, there is no litter. The waitlist carries forward.
About.story3: A Labrador line is planned. Until then every published dog and puppy here is a Golden Retriever. Breed is a field on the record, not a theme we redesign the site around.
About.visitBody: {location}. Visits are by arrangement once we have spoken.

ProgramValues.healthBody: Every dam and sire is hip, elbow, eye and DNA screened before a mating is planned. Clearances sit on the dog’s page and we send the paperwork with the puppy.
ProgramValues.kitchenBody: Litters are born in the house and raised with Puppy Culture handling: novel surfaces and sounds, early crate and car time, and daily time underfoot with the family.
ProgramValues.matchTitle: Matched, not picked from a photo
ProgramValues.matchBody: We match approved families to puppies at four weeks, by temperament. Collar colour is a label, not a personality.
ProgramValues.lifeTitle: A lifetime of the same number
ProgramValues.lifeBody: You keep our phone for the life of the dog. Questions about food, a limp, or a new baby — we answer them.

Health.title: Health & guarantee
Health.headline: Health testing and our guarantee
Health.lede: Placeholder terms until the real protocol and contract land. Nothing here is a legal offer — it is the shape of what we will stand over.
Health.hipsBody: BVA/KC scoring on every breeding dog before a first mating, and again if we use them later. We do not breed on scores we would not keep ourselves.
Health.eyesBody: Annual eye examination. A litter is not planned on a stale certificate.
Health.dnaBody: prcd-PRA and the current Golden Retriever panel (ICT / GR-PRA1 / GR-PRA2). We do not mate two carriers of the same condition.
Health.goes1: Microchip, first vaccination, worming record, and a vet check in the week before going home
Health.goes2: A starter pack of the food they are on, and a written feeding note
Health.goes4: Our phone number, for the life of the dog
Health.g1: If a puppy is diagnosed by a vet, within 24 months, with a hereditary condition that severely affects quality of life, we will work with you on the next step — a contribution toward treatment, or help finding a path that is fair. We do not disappear.
Health.g2: This is not a cash-back scheme and it is not a promise that a living animal will never be ill. It is a promise that we stay in the conversation.
Health.g3: A written contract will replace these paragraphs before any puppy leaves. Until then, treat this page as intent, not terms.

Faq.title: FAQ
Faq.description: How applying, matching, and going home works at Rathmore.
Faq.headline: Questions we are asked
Faq.q1: How do I apply for a puppy?
Faq.a1: Use the application form. Tell us about your home and which litter you are hoping for. We read every note and write back. No deposit is taken online — a public click is a request, not a reservation.
Faq.a2: At four weeks, in waitlist order, by temperament. You do not pick a collar colour from a photograph.
Faq.a3: From eight weeks, once they are microchipped, first-vaccinated, wormed and vet-checked. We will give you a date once the litter is on the ground.
Faq.q4: Do you take a deposit online?
Faq.a4: No. If we offer you a puppy we will talk through the deposit and the contract by email. The website never takes payment.
Faq.q5: What if this litter is full?
Faq.a5: Join the waitlist. Approved families carry forward to the next planned litter. We do not run a separate “maybe later” list.
Faq.a6: Yes, once we have spoken and you are on the list for a current or planned litter. We are a family home, not a showroom — visits are by arrangement.
Faq.a7: Golden Retrievers today. A Labrador line is planned. Breed is listed on each dog and litter.
Faq.a8: County Meath, Ireland. We do not publish a street address.

Voices.q1: They knew every puppy by temperament, not by collar colour. Ours was matched to us before we had even chosen a name.
Voices.q2: Two years on and the health testing still gives us peace of mind. Any question we send gets a real answer the same day.
Voices.q3: He came home settled, crate-happy and used to the car. You can tell the first eight weeks were done with care.
